title: fix: classify filtered streams without usage as content rejections
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix streamed `finish_reason: "content_filter"` without usage being counted as a 502 outage. Reuse the existing 422 `content_policy_violation` tracking path.
- Preserve current billing when valid usage is present; requests without usage remain unbilled. Providers can charge for filtered output: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-foundry/openai/concepts/content-streaming?view=foundry-classic
- Leave response bytes, usage validation, retries, and provider configuration unchanged. No model-specific rules or new parser.
- Add regression coverage through the real stream validator and tracker. Verified the missing-usage case fails before the fix.
- Validation: 136 focused tests and Gen typecheck pass. Local tests used a temporary config omitting only the unrelated `unhandled_rejection_after_microtask_checkpoint` flag, unsupported by the installed test runtime; no test-setup changes included.

gist.headline: The filter found its label
gist.blurb: Some filtered streaming replies arrived without usage and got mistaken for a 502-shaped outage. They now take the proper content-policy path, while valid provider usage still gets counted exactly as before.
gist.summary: Streamed responses ending with `finish_reason: "content_filter"` and no usage are now tracked as 422 `content_policy_violation` events instead of 502 outages, while filtered streams with valid usage retain existing billing.
gist.impact: Developers get accurate content-rejection reporting for usage-less filtered streams, and providers that report valid filtered-output usage continue to be billed normally.
gist.visual_concept: A streaming terminal sends a harmless-looking pixel text stream into a cozy garden content filter that gently redirects it to a clearly labeled 422 basket rather than an alarming 502 storm cloud. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, observes the route while a CRT monitor robot checks the event ledger; flowering code-plants represent the unchanged valid-usage and billing path.
